patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content and a split layout featuring text on one side and a list or image gallery on the other, maintaining a consistent central content column.
Section headings are consistently large and bold, creating strong visual anchors, while body text is smaller and uses a lighter weight for readability.
A cool blue-grey (#abb8c3) is used as a prominent accent color for background sections and large, semi-transparent branding elements, contrasting with the dominant light background and dark text.

The header transforms from a full navigation bar to a compact version with a hamburger menu and smaller logo upon scroll, while a large background text element parallaxes at a slower rate than the foreground content.
Key information, such as 'Our Promise' and 'Our Services', is presented using numbered lists where each number is enclosed in a distinct circular background.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar dynamically shrinks and changes its layout upon scroll, reducing the logo size and collapsing secondary links into a hamburger menu, while retaining the main call-to-action button.
A large, semi-transparent text element of the brand name is positioned in the background and scrolls at a slower rate than the main content, creating a subtle parallax effect and adding depth.
Content sections appear to slide or fade into view as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging reveal experience as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold headings (~4-5x body text) establish clear hierarchy, complemented by legible body text with comfortable line spacing.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for buttons and image corners, with distinct pill shapes for numbered list items.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with an airy hero section transitioning to a more structured, comfortable density in content grids and lists.

standout: The site distinctively integrates its brand name, 'St Kilda Orthodontics', as a large, semi-transparent, parallaxing background element that scrolls independently, adding a unique layer of brand presence and visual depth beyond typical static backgrounds.
